configs.description: The chassis as Juniper ships MX10004-BASE. One routing and control board with a cover over the second slot. Two power supplies with a cover over the third, fans, and a cover in each of the four line-card slots. Line cards are ordered separately.
configs.name: base

gaps.wanted: a photograph of a real RCB's model label. The board in this chassis's own photographs carries four SFP cages numbered 0-3 and no BITS, ToD, RESET or Online/Offline hardware, which matches neither Juniper faceplate figure - not Figure 46 (JNP10K-RE1 family, two reserved XGE cages) nor Figure 45 (JNP10K-RE3 family). juniper/jnp10k-re1@2 follows the figure it is named for; the detail is in provenance/which-board-the-photographs-show on that contract. The label does not resolve at the scale of any photograph held here.
the JNP10K-PWR-AC3, DC2 and DC3 faces (AC3 adds four feeds A0/A1/B0/B1 and six LEDs; only AC2 is photographed usably).

a flat figure or square-on photograph of the JNP10K-PWR-AC2 face; the guide gives its outer size (Table 22) and a photograph at an angle, so juniper/jnp10k-pwr-ac2@2 refits the face of version 1 to 91.4 x 88.9 mm by estimate
LC2101, LC4800 and LC4802 faceplates - the guide names them and gives dimensions and power, but the extraction has no usable face art; only LC9600 and LC480 are modelled.
legible FPC slot labels - the top-down 0-3 order follows the family convention, not a readable print.
a vendor dimension for the RCB face - the FRU table covers chassis, cards and PSUs but not the RCB; 389 mm is photo-derived.

the switch fabric boards (JNP10004-SF2) and their cover (JNP10004-SF-BLNK) sit inside the chassis behind the fan trays, where no face shows them. Vendor count is five boards and one cover on the base; none is drawn.

an `attrs.performance` section; `cpu`, `memory` in a missing `attrs.platform` section; one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in `attrs.power`; one of `operating-temp`, `operating-temp-f2b`, `operating-temp-b2f` in a missing `attrs.environmental` section (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 11 bays (front 6, rear 5) - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

power.note: datasheet-table - the guide capacity table: two JNP10K-PWR-AC2 at high power deliver 11,000 W, three 16,500 W. The MX10000 datasheet states typical power consumption 7.5 kW, fully loaded, naming no ambient or side - carried as power-typical-w. Its footnote calling the figures power supply ratings is attached to the power system rating row, not to this one. The guide rates every FRU by ambient (Table 55, including the fan trays: JNP10004-FAN2 651 W, JNP10004-FAN3 880 W) and works an example of 10,082 W for an MX10004-PREMIUM with four MX10K-LC9600 (3002 W + 7080 W) - a sample, not carried

rear.note: datasheet-table and photo - each supply bay is 91.4 x 88.9 mm, the JNP10K-PWR-AC2 as the guide's Table 22 gives it (3.6 in. wide, 3.5 in. high; guide page 72), and the three stand one above the next with no gap, as the rear studio figure g101087 (Figure 3) shows them: PSU 0 top, PSU 2 bottom, as the printed arrows in the figure, with a label strip above PSU 0 and the earthing terminal's strip below PSU 2. The cover over PSU 2 follows the supply's size as juniper/jnp10k-pwr-blnk@2; juniper/jnp10k-pwr-blnk@1 is kept for a saved rack that names it. The bays were 84.0 x 97.0 mm, the size the supply was drawn from that photograph, and spread over the height of the fan trays. The figure, anchored per-axis to the 442 mm body, puts the stack's top at about 23 mm. The guide's Table 9 gives the fan tray 6.6 in. (16.8 cm, about 167.6 mm) wide and 12.08 in. (30.68 cm) high (guide page 48), and juniper/jnp10004-fan2@2 is drawn at that size; juniper/jnp10004-fan2@1, 176 x 293 mm from the photograph, is kept for a saved rack that names it. The two fan bays are 167.6 x 306.8 mm and stand against the supply column and against each other, as Figure 3 and Figure 21 show them, from the top of the chassis (y 1.6, centred in the 310 mm). 91.4 + 2 x 167.6 mm is 426.6 mm of the 442 mm body, and no figure shows the other 15.4 mm, so it is left empty at the right edge, an estimate. The PSU 0 and FAN 0 / FAN 1 labels, which Figure 3 prints on the strip above the supplies, sit on that strip

slot-numbering.note: guide - FPC 0-3; drawn top-down 0-3 to match the MX10000-family convention, but no extracted figure prints the slot labels legibly - see gaps
